title: Landeck Castle & District Museum
name: Landeck Castle & District Museum
kurzbeschreibung: Schloss Landeck on a steep cliff: landmark of the Tiroler Oberland with a Romanesque keep, Gothic chapel, and interactive local history museum.
beschreibung:
Overview

The prominently visible Schloss Landeck perches on a steep rock bar high above the district capital of Landeck in the Tiroler Oberland at an altitude of approximately 875 metres. Built at the strategically vital crossroads of ancient alpine transit routes – the Via Claudia Augusta across the Reschenpass and the Arlberg route towards Vorarlberg – the 13th-century fortress once served as a comital court of justice and border stronghold for the Counts of Tyrol. Today, this comprehensively restored landmark houses the prestigious Bezirksmuseum Landeck and a vibrant cultural centre.

Keep, Chapel & Museum

The architectural focal point of the castle complex is the massive, square Romanesque keep, which can be climbed to enjoy breathtaking views across the Landeck valley basin, the Inntal, and the Lechtaler Alpen. A remarkable art-historical treasure is the Gothic castle chapel, adorned with rare frescoes from the 14th and 16th centuries. Across multiple floors in the museum area, visitors explore a multifaceted permanent exhibition dedicated to turbulent regional history: thematic highlights include the ancient Roman road Via Claudia Augusta, historic mining and forestry traditions, sacred wood carvings, and the moving fate of the Oberland Schwabenkinder. Contemporary art galleries with rotating exhibitions by regional artists round off the cultural experience.

Visit & Getting There

Schloss Landeck and the Bezirksmuseum are open daily from early May to late October from 10:00 to 17:00 (special winter opening hours during cultural events and Advent markets). Admission fees (2025/2026 season): adults approx. €7.00, seniors approx. €6.00, children and youths (aged 6 to 15) approx. €3.50, small children free; family ticket approx. €15.00. Holders of the regional TirolWest Card enjoy free admission! Getting there by car: take the Inntalautobahn A12 or S16 Arlbergschnellstraße (exit Landeck), follow signs to the castle (parking directly at the castle rock). On foot: an atmospheric footpath leads from the town centre of Landeck up to the castle in about 15 minutes. By public transport: ÖBB trains to Landeck-Zams station, then continue with the local bus to the Schloss stop.

Tips

In the shaded castle courtyard, the castle café invites visitors to enjoy refreshments, coffee, and homemade cakes. The museum offers an exciting riddle rally with a dedicated explorer map for children. Be sure not to miss Schloss Landeck during the popular summer concerts held in the romantic arcade courtyard.
